deterministic_source_audit.method: Reconstruct the generator exactly from current source without model execution and count UTF-8 bytes/characters of every generated prompt. All generated prompts are ASCII, so byte count equals character count.
deterministic_source_audit.important_limit: These are source-level byte/character-length statistics, not tokenizer token-count observations. Exact Qwen tokenizer lengths must be taken from the existing native capture receipt when the queued run executes; the harness already emits prompt_tokens.

finding.observation: The structural basis is estimated from the last-token layer-input activation. The generator simultaneously gives semantic targets a highly predictive surface-length signature that is reproduced exactly in calibration and lexically disjoint holdout. Because the nuisance residualizer has no prompt-length, token-position, probe-length or structural-shape nuisance family, the derived class directions can retain a sequence-position/surface-form component.
finding.mechanistic_relevance: The native capture harness tokenizes each prompt, then indexes the layer-input row at n_tokens-1. Thus any target-correlated tokenizer length changes the absolute sequence index of the measured state. Qwen3-0.6B configuration uses rotary positional encoding parameters (rope_theta present), so position is an explicit model computation input; this makes tokenizer-count counterbalancing a causal-design requirement rather than a cosmetic formatting preference.
finding.claim_boundary: The source-level length confound does not prove that native steering is caused by position or that the queued result will fail. It does show that lexical disjointness plus opaque-code counterbalance is insufficient to identify an abstract semantic coordinate when the measured last-token state is not position/length counterbalanced.

counterhypotheses.statement: The calibration class means partly encode prompt/probe length and the resulting last-token position, and the cvec exploits a correlated positional/surface feature rather than a reusable abstract relation state.

Counts and arrangement of punctuation/rule/fact syntax create a task-specific structural-complexity direction that transfers to holdout because calibration and holdout preserve the same grammar and target-specific shape.

successor_discriminator_delta.name: POSITION_LENGTH_ORTHOGONALIZED_STRUCTURAL_GATE
required_changes_after_the_frozen_queued: Do not alter or redispatch the already frozen queued run; preserve it as the preregistered bounded discriminator.

For the successor, make semantic target x output code x query polarity independent of tokenizer token count by construction, preferably with exact equal token-count strata within each factorial cell or deterministic padding whose content and position are independently randomized/counterbalanced.

Bind exact tokenizer IDs/counts from the pinned Qwen3 tokenizer/runtime before any holdout execution and fail closed if target-token-count mutual information is nonzero beyond the preregistered exact criterion.

Add prompt token count, probe token count and structural-shape controls to the calibration-only nuisance audit as defense in depth; do not rely on residualization alone when exact design orthogonalization is possible.
Evaluate leave-one-length-stratum-out or matched-length contrasts so positive causal effects cannot be obtained only in the original target-specific length strata.

Retain the existing strict requirements from the parent Run-2 audit: frozen/preregistered gain, geometry null, per-target positivity, true sign-flip reversal, off-target regression, cross-task-family transfer and replicated factorial cells.
Retain the Run-2 polarity addendum requirement for a complete target x code x query-polarity factorial.
successor_discriminator_delta.acceptance_rule: No abstract-state or canonical semantic J-Space promotion if exact tokenizer token count or last-token position predicts target above the preregistered chance/null criterion in either calibration or holdout, unless the semantic effect survives an exact matched-position causal analysis with the confound orthogonalized by design.

external_research_context.use: Primary model-family context; confirms the Qwen3 family and 0.6B scale.
Primary model configuration exposes max_position_embeddings and rope_theta=1000000 with Qwen3ForCausalLM, supporting explicit positional computation in the exact model family.

external_research_context.source: Activation Scaling for Steering and Interpreting Language Models
external_research_context.use: Methodological context: steering evaluation should include effectiveness and faithfulness and explicitly studies generalization to varying-length prompts; contextual evidence only, not Clay runtime evidence.

integration_with_existing_run2.promotion_rule: R2_B9 is additive. A PASS from queued run 32810213066 remains bounded structural-native component evidence and cannot promote canonical semantic J-Space because the current design does not orthogonalize the last-token capture from target-correlated sequence length/position.

next_exact_action: Do not spawn a duplicate model experiment. Keep run 32810213066 frozen and queued; when it executes, consume its emitted prompt_tokens to quantify exact target-token-count leakage. Regardless of PASS, require a successor design that jointly orthogonalizes target x code x query polarity x exact token count/last-token position and satisfies the existing Run-2 strict causal/generalization gates before semantic J-Space promotion.
